CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   C. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.

   D. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
